verdict.rationale: Treasury has an extensive documented API covering the main operations: FinancialAccount objects, funding, OutboundPayments, ReceivedDebits, Transaction ledger entries and v2 events, plus an official CLI and MCP server. But no evidence states that the API matches everything the Dashboard can do. The direct-business Treasury experience is described as Dashboard and mobile-app access, and the API surface is framed mainly around Connect platforms. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence that the Dashboard-only financial account flows are exposed via the API, a published OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
